Mailchimp gates it behind Essentials and reaches 37 countries compared to Brevo's 180+ Mailchimp wins on depth of content and reporting with 380+ email templates and predictive analytics at a lower entry price Choose Brevo for automations, transactional emails, and SMS in all plans; choose Mailchimp for more integrations and live chat support in paid plans Show more Pricing is the biggest Brevo vs. Mailchimp difference, as Brevo charges by email volume with contact caps below Enterprise, and Mailchimp charges by contacts with a send multiplier. Large list with infrequent sends? Brevo’s cheaper. A small list you send to a lot? Mailchimp’s cheaper. But the cheapest option isn’t necessarily your best pick. Brevo and Mailchimp have different integrations and capabilities across AI, reports, flows, and channels. It all depends on your business size and priorities.
